symptom: The precursor-thread proposal used SCN-023 for Avoidable Human Iteration / Incomplete Preflight, while the canonical Scenario Pack later assigned SCN-023 to the Terraform State HOLD_NETWORK case.
root_cause: Scenario numbering evolved without preserving an explicit lineage map from proposed identifiers to canonical identifiers.
early_signals: The precursor text explicitly names SCN-023 as Avoidable Human Iteration / Incomplete Preflight
The current Scenario Pack explicitly names SCN-023 as Azure/GitHub visible with Terraform State blocked by network
human_cost: Potential ambiguity during retrospective consolidation and risk of believing the preflight scenario was already implemented when only its policy existed.
prevention_rule: Never reuse a canonical scenario ID for a different semantic case; when a historical proposal conflicts, retain the historical label as lineage metadata and allocate the next free canonical ID.
automated_detection: SCN-027 records the historical proposed ID and regression tests exercise the missing preflight behavior.
